claims: Timm's Hill is the highest natural point in the U.S. state of Wisconsin.
Timm's Hill has an elevation of 1,951.5 feet (595 m).
Timm's Hill is located in north-central Wisconsin.
Timm's Hill is located in Timm's Hill County Park.
Timm's Hill County Park is in the Town of Hill in Price County.
The summit of Timm's Hill features a five-story wooden observation tower.
The observation tower provides 360-degree views of the surrounding Northwoods.
Timm's Hill County Park is open year-round.
The main park gate of Timm's Hill County Park is typically open from May through October.
Visitors can sign a registry at Timm's Hill.
Timm's Hill County Park includes access to Bass Lake.
Timm's Hill County Park includes access to Timms Lake.
Timm's Hill County Park features 9 miles of non-motorized trails.
The non-motorized trails in Timm's Hill County Park connect to the National Ice Age Trail.
The non-motorized trails in Timm's Hill County Park connect to Rib Lake Ski Area Trails.
Rib Lake Ski Area Trails are groomed for skiing in the winter.

High Point Retreats is a lodging business located on the highest ridge-top in La Crosse County, WI.
